name.fr-FR: Les trois conversions et les trois voies (traduction anglaise)
name.en-US: The Three Ways of the Spiritual Life
name.pt-BR: As três vias da vida espiritual (tradução inglesa)

description.en-US: The three conversions and the three ways of the spiritual life: the purgative, illuminative and unitive ways, and the passage from each to the next. English version of Les trois conversions et les trois voies (1933), Burns Oates, London 1938; Newman Press 1950.
description.pt-BR: As três conversões e as três vias da vida espiritual: via purgativa, iluminativa e unitiva. Versão inglesa de Les trois conversions et les trois voies (1933), Londres, 1938.

sources.edition: The Three Ways of the Spiritual Life, London: Burns Oates & Washbourne, 1938 (Westminster, Md.: Newman Press, 1950), archive.org Lagrange-English; the French original is not open

title.en-US: Chapter I. The life of grace and the importance of the first conversion
Chapter II. The second conversion : entrance into the illuminative way
Chapter III. The third conversion or transformation of the soul: entrance into the unitive way
Chapter IV. The problem of the three stages of the spiritual life in ascetical and mystical theology
Chapter V. Characteristics of the three stages of the spiritual life
Chapter VI. The peace of the kingdom of God: a prelude to the life of heaven
